title: CIA Halted IRS Probe of Offshore Bank: National Security Cited to Quash Tax Investigation of Bahamas Institution
summary: Front-page Wall Street Journal investigative exposé revealing that the Central Intelligence Agency pressured the Department of Justice and the Internal Revenue Service into abandoning its major prosecution of Castle Bank & Trust (Project Haven), because the bank was founded by CIA operative Paul Helliwell and was being actively utilized to channel black-budget funds for covert operations across Latin America and the Far East.
